<!-- pr-reviewer: 5cf0aa9533ae7374a36482f6fdf965474354403a -->
Reviewer: m3 pool job review-4156 (config .claude-team2), claude-opus-5-5, mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

## What the PR does

The PR adds one line to `crates/app/tests/start_exit_shared/hole_order.rs:75`. The `bore()` helper now sets `entry: camcraft_app::machining3d::Entry3D::Plunge`. This repairs the app test build on `main` (#4155). No production code changes.

## What looks good

- The cause is correct. #3828 added the `entry` field to `OpParams::Bore`. #3328 added the `bore()` helper without that field. Each PR was green alone.
- `Entry3D::Plunge` is the same value that the standalone Bore seed uses (`crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs:1065`). Thus the test keeps the behaviour that it had before #3828.
- The body has the readings, the "not exercised" line, `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #4155`.
- Commit subject is a conventional `test(app):` subject.

## Results, merged with main (locally, macOS, host m3)

The PR head `5cf0aa953` has `upstream/main` `dc3679fb5` as its parent. The trial merge is the PR head itself.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (plan: `app start_exit_shared (hole_order::)`) | ok, 1 step, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test start_exit_shared` (full suite) | 40 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` (all app test binaries) | builds, 0 errors |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Extra suites run: none were owed. The diff does not touch `testdata/`, importer code, posts, operations, motion or the example catalog. No golden or recorded program moved.

## Mutation

- I put back the `upstream/main` version of `hole_order.rs` (without the `entry` line) and built `start_exit_shared`. The build is red with the error that #4155 reports:
  ```
  error[E0063]: missing field `entry` in initializer of `camcraft_app::operation::OpParams`
  ```
  With the PR line, the build is green. I restored the file after the check.

## Safety tier

Not a safety-tier review. The PR changes only a test file. It does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation or geometry.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes (not blocking)

- None.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
